issues.where: low center, where the green shoot meets the soil
issues.what: At phone size the opening reads as dark ground with a small green sliver, not a seedling emerging. The rising stem and warming sunrise reward staying, but the subject is difficult to pick out on the first glance.
issues.fix: Open with slightly more of the curved shoot above the soil and give it a faint cool edge light. Keep the warm sunrise reveal so the first two seconds still have a clear payoff.
